messages:
anika-support: War room — hosted inference gateway is returning elevated 5xxs and client timeouts since ~2026-03-15T03:10Z. Multiple customers reporting errors and slow responses. Opening triage. Need oncall, SRE, infra, and support.

jason-oncall: I'm on. Noticed error spike at 03:09:xx UTC from gateway metrics. Pulling logs and tracing.

laura-sre: jumping in — p50 from 120ms -> 2.1s, p95 ~9s. Error ratio to valid requests up ~4x. Starting correlation with auth-proxy and kv-cache metrics.

matt-eng: quick check: kv-cache hit rate dropped sharply at 03:08:50, eviction counts spiked. Possible memory pressure on runtime nodes causing upstream latencies. Trying repro.

claire-ops: scaling inference-pool +2 nodes (hot add). Also increasing gateway replicas by 1. Will monitor for ~5m.

laura-sre: log snippet from gateway (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T03:11:23Z] auth-proxy: POST /introspect timeout after 2s -> upstream timeout
[2026-03-15T03:11:24Z] gateway: route /v1/generate upstream 504 kv-cache-stall
[2026-03-15T03:11:24Z] gateway: retry attempt 1 failed, backend conn reset
```

matt-eng: repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Response shows 504 consistently under load. Trying direct hit to runtime endpoint to isolate auth-proxy vs runtime.

sam-cust-success: customer-reported payloads show many long streaming requests; they saw a surge of retries coming from their side which might have amplified load. They've paused retries for now.

jason-oncall: immediate mitigation applied: 1) rolled back gateway config change from earlier today (v1.4.0 -> v1.3.8), 2) temporarily increased auth-proxy timeout to 10s, 3) enabled fallback route to smaller model for heavy requests. deploy-bot: triggered rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback inference-gateway to v1.3.8 initiated by jason-oncall at 2026-03-15T03:25:12Z :white_check_mark:

claire-ops: after scaling and rollback, error rate dropped ~70% within 3m. Still seeing tail latencies for some customer flows. Monitoring. :eyes:

laura-sre: we collected traces for a failed request — trace shows auth-proxy spend 2.1s waiting for OIDC provider, then gateway retry + runtime queue wait ~1.4s. Root seems multi-factor: auth timeouts + backend queueing from cache miss storm.

matt-eng: suggested short-term: 1) keep rollback, 2) keep auth timeout to 10s for 1h, 3) set circuit-breaker thresholds looser to avoid mass-5xx on transient auth failures, 4) enable prefix-level caching for common prompts.

anika-support: we've notified affected customers with status page update and provided mitigation guidance (pause aggressive client retries, use exponential backoff). CS has open RCA ticket for largest customer.

laura-sre: collecting action items for postmortem:
- A1: Add alert for auth-proxy 5xx spike (>1% of requests in 60s) — owner: laura-sre — due: 2026-03-16T12:00Z
- A2: Increase KV cache memory headroom and add eviction metrics to dashboard — owner: matt-eng — due: 2026-03-18T17:00Z
- A3: Harden runbook for gateway rollback and automated fallback route (doc + playbook) — owner: claire-ops — due: 2026-03-17T09:00Z
- A4: Load-test auth-proxy behavior under OIDC latency and add synthetic check — owner: eng-ml (matt-eng) — due: 2026-03-24T18:00Z
- A5: Postmortem writeup and customer impact timeline — owner: anika-support — due: 2026-03-17T15:00Z

matt-eng: quick note: add a metric for cache eviction storm (evictions/s) to make threshold alerts possible.

jason-oncall: follow-ups I did: stash logs in S3 bucket s3://redwood-incidents/2945678901/, tagged traces, and created a temporary alarm to page if gateway error ratio > 0.5% for 60s. Will handoff to SRE for postmortem.

anika-support: customers updated. CS will follow up individually with repro steps we captured and advise retry/backoff best practices.

claire-ops: closing this war room in 30m unless new 5xx spike appears. Everyone please ack action items. :thumbsup:

sam-cust-success: ack — will coordinate customer rechecks tomorrow morning.

laura-sre: acked, adding incident notes to ops-notes and starting postmortem doc.

matt-eng: ack, will open PR for eviction metrics and schedule a small scale test.

jason-oncall: thanks all. War room closed at 2026-03-15T04:10Z. Postmortem draft expected per A5.
